hook: Even *Stephen Hawking* got a flying wheelchair before GTA VI!
caption:
Stephen Hawking in a rocket powered wheelchair is not something anyone expected to see, but AI made it possible.
AI creator WenvisAI used MVLAND AI tools to create this CGI animation, showing a Hawking inspired character flying through the air with rocket thrusters attached to his wheelchair.
It's a fun example of how AI video tools can turn an absurd idea into a cinematic scene without filming any of it in real life.
